calculations:
The initial state shows SSGTG-1 failed, SSGTG-2 at 100% load, and SSGTG-3 available (B-G3 open). Vital loads SHAFT-1, SHAFT-2, STEER, CHW are powered. Unpowered equipment includes LC-1 (which feeds vital loads like FP-1), ADS, CIWS, RADAR, ECM, COMMS. The goal is to restore these without overloading any generator.

The previous attempts failed because they either didn't restore power or overloaded SSGTG-2 beyond capacity (as seen in the tool results where SSGTG-2 load exceeded 100% when B-G3 was closed and bus ties were added).

Since LC-1 and LC-2 are unpowered, we must bring SSGTG-3 online (B-G3) to take load from SSGTG-2. The first attempt (closing ["B-G3"]) showed that while B-G3 was on, LC-1/LC-2 remained unpowered, indicating the necessary feeder breakers are not closed.

We need to close B-G3 and then find a path for power to LC-1/LC-2. Since SSGTG-2 is at 100%, we must offload it by routing load through SSGTG-3. The previous attempts failed because they added too much load or didn't correctly route the new supply.

I will try closing B-G3 and then using a single feeder breaker that connects to LC-1/LC-2, assuming this is the path needed for vital loads.
